plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner strip: small brand seal, then the full-height bottle, then a large headline, ending on the CTA at the right as the end of the reading line, so nothing collides with the headline.

The bottle anchors the left. The headline and CTA are stacked as one left-aligned block on a shared edge, like the original's panel copy, and the brand seal sits alone at the far right to balance the bottle.
A centered core keeps the original's symmetry: the headline sits over the CTA in the middle of the banner, with the brand seal on the left and the bottle on the right as matching bookends.
